geometry_edits.rationale: Transform the dominant mass into two related wings with a controlled gap so the street edge can become a legible public threshold.
Split across the short axis to create a meaningful entry void and keep the long mass continuous.
Open a bounded void large enough to read as a court/threshold rather than a seam.
Preserve a grounded connector so the composition stays one building with a clear public base.
Size the ground contact to reinforce active frontage.
Lower the public base so the access edge becomes occupiable and legible.

graph_edits.rationale: Retain the dominant compact mass but convert the sealed cantilever gesture into a split mass that can register a clearer public threshold at ground.
Introduce a legible void without destroying the dominant massing idea.
Keep a coherent ground-contact element so the form still reads as one building rather than fragments.
Make the public edge legible as a grounded threshold rather than a sealed box.
Lower the opening so the access edge reads as occupiable public space.

rationale: The candidate is a coherent compact object in all four views, but it reads as a generic stepped/torqued block rather than a neighborhood-living mass with an active street threshold. The parcel containment appears satisfied, yet the dominant gesture does not convincingly organize a usable public void or entry seam toward the verified access edge; the blue frontage is met by a mostly sealed side rather than a clear ground response. The section is also weak for the stated brief: there is no clear inhabited terrace/court logic, only a compressed sculptural mass with shallow surface breaks. It is not a hard typology mismatch, but program fit is below threshold because the visible massing does not adequately support active frontage + public void + calm upper hierarchy.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: Tower/commercial language is much taller and more vertical than this low neighborhood-living candidate; only the silhouette-control principle transfers.
reference_assessments.transferable_principle: Tall mass with a legible stepped/tapered profile and a clear dominant datum can still read as one coherent object across views.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: Office tower typology and vertical scale do not match the candidate's compact mixed neighborhood brief.
reference_assessments.transferable_principle: A single dominant volume can be softened by curvature/twist while preserving a clear hierarchy and continuous mass.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: Restaurant/cafe reference is more pavilion-like and publicly open than this sealed, compact mass; do not imitate its low-rise proportion literally.
reference_assessments.transferable_principle: A low horizontal public base can be paired with a more assertive upper element while keeping ground legibility.
